hypothesis: With stage, played card and concealment held fixed, bonus-taking versus deferral can still trade off column quality against draw and denial; terminal accounting is required.
source_rule: First four distinct saved self-play deals at or after game 14400 with at least one same-card/same-concealment legal action in both classes at exactly prefix 17. Save every screened source and rejected reason before outcomes; no winner/score selection.
candidate_rule: For each common card/concealment key select each class's highest search visit probability (prior then ID ties). Select the key by maximum sum of the two visit probabilities, then summed prior, then numeric card/concealment key. No terminal outcome is used for selection.
continuation: Both seats stateless isolated fixed-clock A9, 64 samples, each proof cap 1000000 instrumented units; incomplete proof discarded. Not production time-limited A9 strength.
null_control: Two reused and one fresh decision per root on identical state/seed; require same action and full sample count.
accounting: terminal utility and score margin by source pair
root bonus card played or retained
target-column first completer and final winner
gate: Mechanism pilot only; no live adoption. Report all source-pair differences separately by fixed group. No feature/rate tuning on confirmation.
remaining_confound: The legal placements use different columns and change subsequent states; this still does not isolate a rules-level marginal draw/denial effect.
runtime: Normal save-stop, both live OS locks free then acquire both, one nice15 runner, wall plus monotonic 1200 seconds and per-call limits, preserve latest bytehash before/after. Resume unchanged v3 only after verification. No paid computation.
